## Summary
Greenfield build of **StockRoom**: a NestJS 11 + Prisma 6 (Postgres) API and an Angular 22 SPA implementing role-based (clerk/manager) inventory management with per-location stock levels, atomic IN/OUT/TRANSFER movements, a low-stock report, and a filterable movement audit log.

## Scope

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace the `# Inventory-04` stub with StockRoom setup/run instructions.
- `.github/workflows/colossus-deploy.yml` — **do not touch** (marked managed by Colossus).

### Files to create

**Root**
- `docker-compose.yml` — local Postgres 18 + backend + frontend.
- `.env.example`, `.gitignore`.

**Backend — `backend/`**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — datasource, generator, models below.
- `prisma/seed.ts` — 2 users, 3 locations, 8 items, opening stock levels, sample movements.
- `src/main.ts` — `app.setGlobalPrefix('api')`, global `ValidationPipe({whitelist:true, transform:true})`, CORS.
- `src/app.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`
- `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/health/deep` (deep runs `SELECT 1`).
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`, `public.decorator.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/signup.dto.ts`
- `src/items/` — `items.module.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`
- `src/locations/` — module, controller, service, `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts`
- `src/movements/` — module, controller, service, `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts`
- `src/reports/` — `reports.module.ts`, `reports.controller.ts`, `reports.service.ts`

**Frontend — `frontend/`**
- Angular 22 standalone workspace: `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `Dockerfile`, `nginx.conf`, `.dockerignore`
- `src/index.html` — `<title>StockRoom</title>`
- `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`, `provideAnimations`

- `src/app/pages/items/item-list/`, `item-detail/`, `item-form/`
- `src/app/pages/locations/location-list/`, `location-form/`

### Dependencies
- Backend: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport}@^11`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `prisma@^6` + `@prisma/client@^6`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `bcryptjs`, `@types/bcryptjs`; dev: `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`.
- Frontend: `@angular/*@^22`, `@angular/material@^22`, `rxjs`.
- Infra: `postgres:18-alpine`, `node:22-alpine`, `nginx:alpine`.

### Integrations
None — the spec declares no third-party APIs or services.

### Assumptions
- **Prisma pinned to `^6`.** Prisma 7 is ESM-only and requires `prisma.config.ts`; Prisma 8 replaces the client with a contract-first, namespace-qualified API. Both are incompatible with NestJS 11's CommonJS build without significant extra work. Pin `prisma@^6`/`@prisma/client@^6` in `package.json` — do not use `@latest`.
- **Auth model is `full_auth`** (spec has non-admin authenticated actors). Public routes: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`. Signup creates **role=clerk only**, so it cannot bypass the "clerk cannot manage the catalog" scenario. The seeded manager is the only manager.
- **Low-stock predicate:** `SUM(stockLevel.qty) <= item.reorderAt`.
- **Locations seeded as `Zone A`, `Zone B`, `Zone C`** (name), zones `A`, `B`, `C` — matches scenario wording literally.
- Validation failures (duplicate SKU, insufficient stock, bad movement shape) return **400** with `{message}`. RBAC denial returns **403**, missing/invalid token **401**.
- `bcryptjs` (pure JS) over `bcrypt` to avoid native compilation in Alpine images.
- Deleting an item/location that has stock or movement history returns 400 — the audit log must stay referentially intact.
- JWT in `localStorage`, 24h expiry, `Authorization: Bearer` header.
- Item detail's per-location breakdown and the list's total-on-hand are both derived from `StockLevel`, never stored on `Item`.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Repo skeleton and Postgres
**Files:** `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example`, `.gitignore`
**Change:** Three services — `db` (postgres:18-alpine, healthcheck `pg_isready`), `backend` (depends_on db healthy), `frontend`. `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://stockroom:stockroom@db:5432/stockroom`, `JWT_SECRET`.

### Step 2: Prisma schema
**File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** `enum Role { clerk manager }`, `enum MovementType { IN OUT TRANSFER }`.
- `User(id String @id @default(cuid()), email String @unique, passwordHash, role Role)`
- `Item(id, sku String @unique, name, description String?, unit, reorderAt Int)`
- `Location(id, name String @unique, zone)`
- `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0))` with `@@unique([itemId, locationId])`
- `Movement(id, type MovementType, itemId, fromLocId String?, toLocId String?, qty Int, note String?, userId, createdAt DateTime @default(now()))` with `@@index([itemId])`, `@@index([createdAt])`. Relations to `Location` need named relations (`fromLoc`/`toLoc`) since there are two FKs to the same model.
Run `prisma migrate dev --name init`.

### Step 3: Prisma service + health
**Files:** `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `src/health/health.controller.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit` calling `$connect()`. Mark `PrismaModule` `@Global()`. Health controller is `@Public()`; `/deep` executes `this.prisma.$queryRaw\`SELECT 1\`` and returns `{status:'ok', db:'up'}`, 503 on failure.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `src/auth/*`
**Change:** `AuthService.validate(email, password)` → `bcrypt.compare`; `login()` signs `{sub, email, role}`. `JwtStrategy` validates and returns the user record. Register `JwtAuthGuard` and `RolesGuard` as `APP_GUARD` providers in `AppModule` so **every** endpoint is protected by default — this satisfies "unauthenticated caller → 401" globally. `@Public()` opts out (login, signup, health). `@Roles('manager')` + `RolesGuard` → 403.
Endpoints: `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/signup`, `GET /api/auth/me`.

### Step 5: Items and Locations CRUD
**Files:** `src/items/*`, `src/locations/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/items` (any authenticated role) returns items with `totalQty` computed from included `stockLevels`. `GET /api/items/:id` additionally returns `stockLevels: [{location, qty}]`. `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` carry `@Roles('manager')`. Catch Prisma `P2002` on `sku` → `BadRequestException('SKU already exists')`. Locations mirror this shape; `GET /api/locations` is readable by clerks (needed to populate the movement form's location selects).

### Step 6: Atomic movements — the critical step
**File:** `src/movements/movements.service.ts`
**Change:** `create()` wraps everything in `prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {...})`.
- DTO validation by type: `IN` requires `toLocId` and forbids `fromLocId`; `OUT` requires `fromLocId`; `TRANSFER` requires both and `fromLocId !== toLocId`. `qty` must be `@IsInt() @Min(1)`.
- **Decrement (OUT/TRANSFER source):** a single guarded statement —
  `const r = await tx.stockLevel.updateMany({ where: { itemId, locationId: fromLocId, qty: { gte: qty } }, data: { qty: { decrement: qty } } })`
  then `if (r.count === 0) throw new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock')`. Because the availability test is part of the `WHERE` clause, there is no read-then-write window; concurrent OUTs cannot drive the balance negative, and the throw rolls the transaction back so the stored balance is unchanged.
- **Increment (IN/TRANSFER destination):** `tx.stockLevel.upsert({ where: { itemId_locationId: {...} }, create: { qty }, update: { qty: { increment: qty } } })`. Wrap in a catch for `P2002` (concurrent first-time insert) that retries once as a plain `update`.
- Write the `Movement` row inside the same transaction, stamped with the authenticated `userId`.
- `GET /api/movements` — `@Roles('manager')`, filters `itemId`, `type`, `from`, `to` (applied to `createdAt` as `gte`/`lte`), paginated, `include: { user: {select:{email}}, item, fromLoc, toLoc }`, ordered `createdAt desc`.

### Step 7: Low-stock report
**File:** `src/reports/reports.service.ts`
**Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock`, `@Roles('manager')`. Fetch items with `stockLevels`, compute `totalQty`, filter `totalQty <= reorderAt`, return `{item, totalQty, reorderAt, shortfall}` sorted by shortfall descending.

### Step 8: Seed
**File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** Idempotent `upsert`s — `manager@demo` (role manager) and `clerk@demo` (role clerk), both `Demo1234!` hashed with bcryptjs; locations `Zone A`/`Zone B`/`Zone C`; 8 items with varied `reorderAt`; opening `StockLevel` rows arranged so **at least one item sits at or below its reorder point** (so the low-stock report is non-empty on a fresh boot) and at least one item is stocked in two locations (so the per-location breakdown scenario is demonstrable); a handful of historical `Movement` rows so the audit log renders. Wire `"prisma": {"seed": "ts-node prisma/seed.ts"}`.

### Step 9: Angular shell, auth, and the SMOKE_MARKER
**Files:** `src/index.html`, `src/app/shell/shell.component.ts`, `pages/login/`, `core/auth.*`
**Change:** `authInterceptor` attaches the bearer token and routes 401 responses to `/login`. `AuthService` holds the current user in a signal, restored from `localStorage` on boot.
**Critical:** the root URL redirects an unauthenticated visitor to `/login`, so the login page itself must render the literal text **StockRoom** as its heading (plus `<title>StockRoom</title>` and the shell toolbar for authenticated views). This is what the Playwright oracle asserts; putting the brand only inside the authenticated shell would fail the smoke test.

### Step 10: Angular routes — every state URL-addressable
**File:** `src/app/app.routes.ts`
**Change:**
- `/login`, `/signup` — public, `data.flow`
- `/` → redirect `/items`
- `/items` — `authGuard`; `?q=` and `?lowStock=` bound to query params
- `/items/new`, `/items/:id/edit` — `roleGuard('manager')`
- `/items/:id` — detail with per-location breakdown
- `/locations`, `/locations/new`, `/locations/:id/edit` — `roleGuard('manager')`
- `/movements/new` — `authGuard` (clerk + manager)
- `/movements` — `roleGuard('manager')`; filters `?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=` restored from the URL on load
- `/reports/low-stock` — `roleGuard('manager')`
- `**` → `/items`
Every entry carries `data.flow`. Filter state lives in query params, never in component-only state.

### Step 11: Feature components
**Change:** Angular Material tables/forms. Item list columns: sku, name, unit, reorderAt, totalQty (row highlighted when at/below threshold). Movement form: item select, type radio (IN/OUT/TRANSFER), conditionally-shown from/to location selects driven by the type control, qty, note. Nav links for manage/report/log render only when `auth.user().role === 'manager'`.

### Step 12: Dockerfiles
**Files:** `backend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/nginx.conf`
**Change:**
- Backend: multi-stage node:22-alpine → `npm ci`, `npx prisma generate`, `nest build`. Entrypoint runs `npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed && node dist/main.js`. `@prisma/client` and the generated client must be present in the runtime stage — copy `node_modules/.prisma` and `node_modules/@prisma` explicitly.
- Frontend: build stage `ng build`, then copy **`dist/frontend/browser`** (Angular 17+ output layout — not `dist/frontend`) into `nginx:alpine`.
- `nginx.conf`: `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;` for SPA deep links (required — without it every route from Step 10 404s on refresh) and `location /api { proxy_pass http://backend:3000; }`.

## Testing Strategy
- **Backend e2e (Jest + supertest), one assertion per spec scenario:** 401 on every endpoint with no token; clerk POST `/api/items` → 403; duplicate SKU → 400 and item count unchanged; IN 50 into Zone A → balance 50 + movement row present; OUT 20 → 30; TRANSFER 10 A→B → A=20, B=10, total unchanged; OUT 10 against 5 on hand → 400 **and re-read balance still 5** (proves rollback); item at 12/reorderAt 10 after OUT 5 appears in low-stock, item at 40 does not; audit log returns actor email/item/type/qty/timestamp; audit log filtered by `itemId` and by `from`/`to` returns only matches.
- **Concurrency check:** fire two simultaneous OUT requests for the full available quantity; exactly one must succeed and the balance must not go negative.
- **Frontend:** Playwright smoke asserting the app root renders "StockRoom"; login as clerk → item list and movement entry visible, manage/report/log nav absent; login as manager → all views reachable; deep-link `/movements?itemId=…` directly and confirm the filter is applied from the URL.
- **Boot:** `docker compose up` → `GET /api/health/deep` returns `db: up`; both demo accounts log in.

## Risks
- **Prisma major-version drift is the single largest build risk.** Any `npm install prisma@latest` pulls Prisma 8, whose contract-first client and ESM-only packaging will break the NestJS build outright. Pin `^6` in `package.json` and do not run `prisma@latest` codegen commands.
- **The smoke marker and the auth redirect conflict.** If "StockRoom" is placed only in the authenticated shell, the oracle loads `/`, gets bounced to `/login`, and finds nothing. Verify the brand text renders on the unauthenticated login view.
- **Angular build output path** changed to `dist/<project>/browser` in v17+; a Dockerfile copying `dist/frontend` produces an empty nginx root that still serves a 200 on `/` — a silent failure.
- **Non-atomic movement handling** is the likeliest correctness bug. A read-then-write availability check passes tests serially and fails under the concurrency check; the guarded `updateMany` in Step 6 is not optional.
- **Seed idempotency:** the container entrypoint reruns the seed on every start. Use `upsert` keyed on `email`/`sku`/`name`, and guard the sample movement/stock inserts so restarts don't inflate balances or duplicate audit entries.
- **Two FKs from `Movement` to `Location`** require explicit named relations in the Prisma schema; omitting them is a `prisma validate` error.
- Seeded demo credentials are well-known and must be rotated before any non-demo use.
